message.content:
I can't actually make reservations for you, but I can guide you through booking a table for two at an excellent Italian restaurant in downtown Chicago for this Friday night. Based on my search, here are some top options with reservation information:

## Top Recommendations for Downtown Chicago Italian

### 1. **Monteverde Restaurant & Pastificio** (West Loop)
- **Address:** 1020 W Madison St, Chicago, IL 60607
- **Why go:** Widely considered the best pasta in Chicago, with a glass-walled pasta lab visible to diners. Chef Sarah Grueneberg is a James Beard winner.
- **Reservations:** Open 30 days out at 10:00 AM on **Resy**
- **Price:** $90–140 per person with wine
- **Hours Friday:** 11:00am–10:30pm

### 2. **RPM Italian** (River North)
- **Address:** 52 W Illinois St, Chicago, IL 60654
- **Why go:** Sleek, modern, celebrity-backed restaurant with excellent pasta and a lively atmosphere. Known for the lobster-pasta cart wheeled tableside.
- **Reservations:** Book at https://www.rpmrestaurants.com/rpm-italian-chicago/reserve/
- **Price:** $90–150 per person with wine

### 3. **Alla Vita** (West Loop)
- **Address:** 564 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60661
- **Why go:** Beautiful, airy, plant-filled space from Boka Restaurant Group. Family-style Italian-American classics with modern refinement.
- **Reservations:** https://www.allavitachicago.com/reservations
- **Price:** $$$

### 4. **Ciccio Mio** (River North area)
- **Why go:** Intimate setting, classic flavors. Reservations released 21 days in advance for groups up to six.
- **Reservations:** https://www.cicciomio.com/

### 5. **Volare Ristorante Italiano** (Streeterville/Downtown)
- **Address:** 201 E Grand Ave, Chicago, IL 60611
- **Why go:** Classic white-tablecloth Italian just off the Magnificent Mile. Decades of service, traditional menu.

## How to Book for This Friday:

1. **For Monteverde:** Download the **Resy app** or visit resy.com — search "Monteverde" and look for Friday availability
2. **For RPM Italian:** Visit https://www.rpmrestaurants.com/rpm-italian-chicago/reserve/ directly
3. **For Alla Vita:** Visit https://www.allavitachicago.com/reservations

**Pro tip:** Friday nights at top Chicago Italian restaurants fill up fast. If your preferred spot is booked, try calling directly — restaurants sometimes hold tables or have last-minute cancellations. You might also consider slightly earlier (5:30-6:00 PM) or later (9:00-9:30 PM) seating for better availability.
